-- the outage first, then the Friday quote, then the bill
-- due in a month, and the newsletter last
SELECT body FROM (VALUES
    ('Newsletter: our autumn catalog is here. No reply needed.'),
    ('Our checkout page is down and customers cannot pay'),
    ('Reminder: your invoice is due in 30 days'),
    ('Please send the signed quote by Friday')) AS t(body)
ORDER BY thinkthen_probability(
    '{"decide": "Does this need an answer today?"}', body) DESC;
